SELECT i.i_item_id,
       SUM(s.sum_quantity)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(s.cnt_quantity), 0)::numeric AS agg1,
       SUM(s.sum_list_price)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(s.cnt_list_price), 0)::numeric AS agg2,
       SUM(s.sum_coupon_amt)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(s.cnt_coupon_amt), 0)::numeric AS agg3,
       SUM(s.sum_sales_price)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(s.cnt_sales_price), 0)::numeric AS agg4
FROM (
    SELECT ss.ss_item_sk,
           COUNT(ss.ss_quantity) AS cnt_quantity,
           SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS sum_quantity,
           COUNT(ss.ss_list_price) AS cnt_list_price,
           SUM(ss.ss_list_price) AS sum_list_price,
           COUNT(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS cnt_coupon_amt,
           SUM(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS sum_coupon_amt,
           COUNT(ss.ss_sales_price) AS cnt_sales_price,
           SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales_price
    FROM (SELECT cd_demo_sk FROM customer_demographics WHERE cd_gender = 'F' AND cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd_education_status = 'College') AS cd
    JOIN store_sales AS ss ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001) AS dd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    JOIN (SELECT p_promo_sk FROM promotion WHERE p_channel_email = 'N' OR p_channel_event = 'N') AS promo ON ss.ss_promo_sk = promo.p_promo_sk
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk
) AS s
JOIN item AS i ON s.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
GROUP BY i.i_item_id
ORDER BY i.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
